summary: Novonix filed a 6-K attaching its quarterly activities and Appendix 4C cash flow report, an Australian quarterly update (the US equivalent of a quarterly report/press release). Terms disclosed are operational, not transactional: selection for a South Korea-US infrastructure initiative (explicitly not a funding commitment), a non-binding MOU with ACP Technologies for pitch-coated synthetic graphite anode material, ongoing Riverside customer qualification, and an amortization event under the Yorkville convertible debenture requiring US$7 million repayments in September and October. No price, stake, premium or deal structure is stated; watch qualification timing against the H2 2027 mass-production target and debenture amortization liquidity.
